description: Eight canonical demo scenarios for ChainGuard AI. Each scenario covers a distinct logistics condition. Use scenarioTag on each dataset record to filter by scenario.

scenarios.title: Normal Shipment – On Schedule
scenarios.summary: A standard shipment moving on an unaffected route with an active carrier. Represents the baseline healthy state.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: No action required. Shipment delivered on schedule. Dashboard shows green status.

scenarios.title: Medium-Risk Shipment – Partial Exposure
scenarios.summary: A high-priority shipment operating on a route that passes near a disruption zone, or with a carrier that has moderate utilisation. Risk is elevated but not immediately actionable.

route.notes: RT-002 is an alternative route being used proactively. Shipment is already safe.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Shipment proceeds without intervention. Risk score remains medium. Monitor carrier capacity.

scenarios.title: High-Risk Shipment – Active Disruption on Route
scenarios.summary: A shipment whose current route is actively disrupted. Delay is confirmed. An alternative route exists but no cold chain is involved. Action should be taken promptly.

route.notes: RT-008 affected by Varanasi road construction. RT-009 (Eastern DFC rail) is clear.

carrier.notes: CONCOR can handle both RT-008 and RT-009. Same carrier, different mode.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Backend recommends switching to RT-009. Delay reduced from 5h to ~2h. No carrier change needed.

scenarios.title: Critical Shipment – Port Strike + Cold-Chain Excursion
scenarios.summary: PRIMARY DEMO SCENARIO. A vaccine shipment is held at JNPT due to a port strike. The carrier is disrupted, the route is blocked, and a temperature excursion is in progress. All three systems — disruption, route recommendation, and cold-chain alert — are triggered simultaneously.

route.notes: RT-001 fully blocked. RT-002 via Nhava Sheva ICD is operational with 18t capacity available.

carrier.notes: CAR-001 disrupted (0 capacity). CAR-005 (Snowman) is cold-chain specialist at Pune. CAR-002 (Blue Dart) also cold-chain capable at Nhava Sheva.

fleet.notes: TR-101 is idle at Nhava Sheva ICD, refrigerated, carrier CAR-005. Ready for immediate dispatch.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Backend issues CRITICAL alert. Recommends: (1) Assign TR-101 for emergency pickup, (2) Reroute via RT-002, (3) Switch carrier to CAR-005 (preferred) or CAR-002.

scenarios.title: Temperature-Sensitive Shipment – Monitoring Active, No Excursion
scenarios.summary: A cold-chain pharmaceutical shipment that is actively monitored. Sensors are nominal. Demonstrates healthy cold-chain monitoring flow — the contrast scenario to D_CRITICAL.

route.notes: RT-005 chosen proactively over RT-004 due to weather risk. Currently clear.

coldChain.warningNote: Single transient spike at Krishnagiri checkpoint. Self-recovered. Not an excursion.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Cold-chain monitoring dashboard shows green with one past warning (CC-015). No recommendation triggered. Delivery on schedule.

scenarios.title: Delayed Shipment – Weather Event
scenarios.summary: A high-priority industrial shipment delayed by cyclone weather advisory on its primary route. Carrier is on-site but movement is restricted. Alternative route available.

route.notes: RT-004 restricted (daytime trucks only). RT-005 via Salem adds 70 km but is unrestricted.

carrier.notes: CAR-007 is on-site but restricted. CAR-003 (VRL Logistics) operates on RT-005 and is available.

fleet.notes: TR-106 is on-site with cargo. Cannot redeploy — must complete delivery.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Backend recommends rerouting via RT-005 (Salem). ETA recovers partially from 5h delay to ~2h delay.

scenarios.title: Disruption-Affected Shipment – Rail Blocked
scenarios.summary: A garment export shipment on a rail corridor that is blocked due to the port strike. The shipment is halted mid-journey. Demonstrates route blockage and the need for port diversion.

route.notes: RT-006 (JNPT rail) blocked. RT-007 (DFC western arm to Mundra) is operational — different destination port, but export can proceed via Mundra.

carrier.notes: CONCOR (CAR-006) operates on RT-007 as well. Spoton (CAR-004) also available on Mundra corridor.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Backend recommends diverting to Mundra via RT-007. Adds ~2 days but unblocks the shipment from an indefinite hold.

scenarios.title: Idle Fleet Redeployment
scenarios.summary: Two idle vehicles are available for redeployment. TR-101 (cold-chain, Nhava Sheva) is the critical redeployment asset for the SHP-102 emergency. TR-109 (standard, Jaipur) is available for general Ahmedabad–Delhi corridor assignment.

idleVehicles.rationale: Only idle cold-chain equipped vehicle within proximity of JNPT. Can reach SHP-102 cargo and dispatch via RT-002 within 2 hours.
Idle on Ahmedabad–Delhi corridor. Can be assigned to any standard cargo on RT-010.

scenarios.expectedOutcome: Backend identifies TR-101 as optimal redeployment asset. Dispatches TR-101 to JNPT yard for emergency cargo transfer and routing via RT-002.
